about: FlowJo 11.2.0 (build 11.2.0.210156, macOS, trial license) opening CytoWeave's FlowJo exports with File > Import FlowJo v10 Workspace, on 2026-10-03. Percentages are FlowJo's %Events column (of the parent population), read from the population tree. FlowJo was available only for a trial, so these numbers are kept here; validation/run.mjs compares CytoWeave's counts with them. FlowJo evaluates gates at its display resolution, so events near a boundary in a dense region can fall on the other side (most visibly the quadrant divider near zero in the built case).

cases.note: Read from the export with logicle and arcsinh scales written as FlowJo biex. D01_Stim's per-sample Lymphocytes adjustment was widened from 0.01 to 100 units for FlowJo 11 to import the file (it fails on a near-identical per-sample gate); D02_Stim's gates are the export's own.

FlowKit's FlowJo 10 workspace, imported into CytoWeave and exported (logicle scales written as biex). FlowJo 11 shows the original FlowJo 10 workspace's aAmine- as 0.836% (it misreads the logicle scales); the export reads 68.73%. FlowJo 11 shows Singlets as 82.90% on the original too (FlowJo 10 saved 82.60%).

observations: Before the fixes in CytoWeave 0.4 FlowJo 11 crashed (engine SIGSEGV) on every CytoWeave export: it needs GraphSettings and GraphEnvironment in each node's Graph.

FlowJo 11 does not import a two-dimensional rectangle open on a side, and evaluates one-dimensional gates as empty; CytoWeave writes every bound, and ranges and splits as rectangles with an unbounded second dimension.

FlowJo 11 misplaces gates on channels with Gating-ML logicle or arcsinh scales (its log: Unsupported Transforms/@type Logicle, ArcSinh), in FlowJo 10's own workspaces too: a Live gate read 4.6% instead of 94%. It reads FlowJo biex correctly, so CytoWeave writes those scales as the closest biex; after that the same gate read 94.38% (CytoWeave 94.36%).

FlowJo 11 gives CytoWeave's exports the same numbers as FlowJo-written originals of the same workspaces (FlowKit's single_ellipse_51_events, simple_diamond_example_quad_gate, 8_color_ICS_boolean_gate_testing).
FlowJo 11 does not import Boolean (And/Or/Not) populations, from FlowJo 10's own workspaces either.
FlowJo 11 fails to import a workspace in which one gate differs between samples by a minute amount (0.01 units at 33,000); a difference of 100 units imports.
FlowJo 11 does not resolve a relative file reference (file:name.fcs); its 'reconnect your missing files' link, pointed at the workspace's folder, finds them.
Ellipses: FlowJo 11 shows 87.23% for the built case's ellipse, CytoWeave 87.09%, CytoML 2.24 80.44% (CytoML reads FlowJo ellipses differently, on FlowJo's own workspaces too).
